patch.value: Adopt pm-cli 2026.7.26 typed authoring SDK: drop the any-cast defineExtension shim and move tests onto the real activation harness

Replace the forced-any defineExtension shim with the real defineExtension and ExtensionApi from the new sdk/authoring subpath, and migrate the nine hand-built api doubles in the test suite to activateExtensionForTest/runRegisteredCommandForTest so registration is verified under the manifest capability grant rather than a permissive stub.

index.ts imports defineExtension and ExtensionApi from @unbrained/pm-cli/sdk/authoring with no any casts; No hand-built ExtensionApi doubles remain in test/brief.test.ts; Activation capabilities are read from manifest.json so an undeclared surface fails the test; npm test passes and pm brief/duplicates/next run in a real installed workspace

value.author: harness:claude-code
value.text: Verified upstream: value imports from @unbrained/pm-cli/sdk/authoring resolve at extension runtime once the package's node_modules is populated (npm install of the declared peer dep). Confirmed by installing the built extension into a throwaway workspace: pm brief, pm brief duplicates (SDK findSimilarItems), pm brief next --explain and pm brief momentum all run. Corrected upstream pm-cli#717 in-thread accordingly.

patch.value: Replaced the any-cast defineExtension shim with the real defineExtension and ExtensionApi from @unbrained/pm-cli/sdk/authoring, and migrated all nine hand-built api doubles onto activateExtensionForTest/runRegisteredCommandForTest with the capability grant read from manifest.json.
Extension definition path free of any casts, tests exercising the real activation contract under manifest capability governance, and no behavior change.

121/121 tests pass; typecheck, build and pack:dry-run clean; functional install into a throwaway workspace confirmed pm brief, pm brief duplicates, pm brief next --explain and pm brief momentum all run.
